title: Subsheaves and quotients of a constructible sheaf on a curve are constructible
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], let $C$ be a separated scheme of finite type over $k$ with $\dim C\le1$, and let $0\to F_1\xrightarrow{\alpha}F\xrightarrow{\beta}F_2\to0$ be a short exact sequence in the abelian category $\Ab(C_{\Et})$ of abelian sheaves on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] whose three terms are torsion [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], so that $(C,F_1)$, $(C,F)$, $(C,F_2)$ are curve coefficient pairs [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting]. If $F$ is constructible in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion] (a finite partition of $C$ into locally closed constructible subschemes on each of which the restriction of $F$ is locally constant with finite stalks), then $F_1$ and $F_2$ are constructible in the same sense.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Proposition 09BH (proposition-constructible-over-noetherian), part (2): on a Noetherian scheme every sub and quotient sheaf of a constructible abelian sheaf is constructible; with Definition 03RW (definition-constructible) and Lemma 095E (lemma-constructible-quasi-compact-quasi-separated), which identifies Stacks' affine-local definition with the global finite partition of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion] on the quasi-compact quasi-separated $C$; $C$ is Noetherian, being of finite type over a field. Cited in the proof of Lemma 0A5C (lemma-ses-statements).
